name: oxford-hack
description: Root developer commands. Application code and shared modules live in src/.

scripts.setup: npm --prefix src/frontend ci && cd src/platform && uv sync --locked
scripts.contracts:generate: cd src/platform && uv run python scripts/generate_contracts.py && uv run python scripts/make_fixtures.py && cd ../frontend && npm run contracts:types
scripts.contracts:check: cd src/platform && uv run python scripts/generate_contracts.py --check && uv run python scripts/make_fixtures.py --check && cd ../frontend && npm run contracts:types:check
